data.narrative:
Airbase is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Ari Rosner and Millen Anand that has raised $5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies across the Defense & Security sector—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $5M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a typical Seed-to-next-stage multiplier of 2.5x, yielding an implied valuation of $12M. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—UFORCE at $1.0B (Seed), Singularity at $400M (Series A), and NODA AI at $125M (Series A)—producing a median peer valuation of $400M with a range of $125M to $1.0B.

The two methods produce a wide triangulated range: low of $11M, median of $206M, and high of $460M. The stage-progression method anchors conservatively to capital deployed; the peer-median approach reflects valuations achieved by later-stage or better-capitalized defense-tech peers. Key uncertainties include whether Airbase's technology differentiation and market timing justify valuation multiples at the upper end of the peer range, and the extent to which early-stage capital efficiency should discount the peer median toward the stage-progression baseline.
